decisions.reason: As a close-to-core design variant that remained visible with its own page into 2024 and fits the firm's aesthetics-led bathroom strategy, it likely meets aspirations well enough to retain under normal portfolio slack.

This product is tightly aligned with the firm's established drainage competence and future-oriented seamless bathroom architecture, so continued dedicated website presence suggests performance at or above aspiration and a strong case to keep it.

Although the firm already appears willing to prune weaker drainage variants quickly and an earlier pump-based solution disappeared, this 2024 launch is still too new and close to the core for immediate withdrawal unless results clearly fall short of aspiration.
